blurb: JBeez Watercraft Rentals offers jet ski, ski boat, and pontoon boat rentals on Center Hill Lake and other Tennessee lakes such as Percy Priest, Old Hickory, and Tim’s Ford. They have a fleet including Yamaha VX WaveRunners and ski boats ranging from smaller runabouts to twin engine jet boats. Pontoon boats can accommodate up to 15 passengers for family outings.
